title: Basic auth with password to be deprecated on Jira cloud APIs - start using API tokens
body:
See: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/deprecation-notice-basic-auth-and-cookie-based-auth/

As of March 15, 2018, in accordance to the [Atlassian REST API Policy](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/atlassian-rest-api-policy/), support for passwords in HTTP basic auth requests will no longer be supported on or after September 15, 2018.

Instead of passwords, you should start using [API tokens](https://confluence.atlassian.com/cloud/api-tokens-938839638.html).
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
I can confirm that jira-connector works with API tokens with no modification.

You get a token from the JIRA dashboard.  Then you simply use the token with basic authentication in place of your password.  No change is necessary to the basic authentication feature in jira-connector.  Maybe a documentation tweak, to explain how to do it.
